_doc: C10 viewport overflow allowlist (f385). A rule needs id, metric, routes (regex), class (intended|followup), a reason of 40+ characters and, for a followup, max (the count of hits may fall, never rise: test_viewport_overflow.mjs compares against HEAD) and a followup number from the receipt. Anything matching no rule fails the sweep. Overflow, off-viewport element and footer defects have no rules: all were fixed.

rules.reason: Nav wordmark backlink, theme toggle and text links under 44px at 360 after the wordmark and burger fix; remaining ones are small nav chips, a CSS pass on the nav is follow-up 5 in the f385 receipt.
Footer links outside the main link columns (seal row and legal strip) measure 15px tall at 360; follow-up 6 in the f385 receipt, needs a footer layout decision.
FAQ and accordion summary rows are 24px tall at 360 across blog, offers and welcome pages; follow-up 2 in the f385 receipt, padding change touches every accordion.
Chip and filter buttons 32px tall at 360 (w4-chip family); follow-up 3 in the f385 receipt, a design-token change to chip height.
Checkbox and small form inputs under 44px at 360; follow-up 4 in the f385 receipt, needs label-wrapped hit areas per form.
Body and card text links 18 to 29px tall at 360, mostly the offers and welcome catalogues; follow-up 1 in the f385 receipt, a list-row padding pass.
